description: Piglins treat Netherite armor like gold. Mod, server plugin and data pack.

mods.name: Piglins like Netherite
mods.description: Tired of swapping your endgame gear for weak gold armor? Makes Piglins neutral when you wear Netherite armor, just like gold armor does.

releases.notes:
Piglins like Netherite 1.1, updated by LucasTHCR.

- Minecraft 26.3 support
- Mod and data pack now load from 1.21.2 on, where the piglin_safe_armor tag first exists
- Mod on Fabric now declares Fabric API, which Fabric needs to load mod data
- Plugin rebuilt for Java 8, so it also starts on older servers that do not run Java 21
